answer: Proof-of-stake functions as a primary Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring economic capital to secure network weight. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces a ridge of prohibitive financial costs, as each additional node requires a stake proportional to the ecosystem value. Like a shifting dune, the security boundary adjusts dynamically to punish malicious actors, while honest agents harvest rewards from the digital orchard of the network, ensuring identity remains bound to intrinsic collateral.
